description.en: Google's Gemini API with a free tier covering Flash / Flash-Lite models (free input & output tokens), generous quotas for light daily use, and no credit card needed for the free tier.
description.zh-Hans: Google Gemini API，免费层覆盖 Flash / Flash-Lite 系列模型（输入输出 token 免费），额度较宽裕适合日常使用，免费层无需绑定信用卡。
description.zh-Hant: Google Gemini API，免费层覆盖 Flash / Flash-Lite 系列模型（输入输出 token 免费），额度较宽裕适合日常使用，免费层无需绑定信用卡。

detail.en: The Gemini API offers a free tier for developers and small projects. Free-tier-eligible models include the Flash and Flash-Lite families (e.g. Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, newer 3.x Flash Lite variants), with free input/output tokens and relatively generous RPM/RPD quotas that are shown in Google AI Studio and change over time. The API is available natively and through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the free tier requires a Google account but no billing/credit card.
detail.zh-Hans: Gemini API 为开发者和小型项目提供免费层。免费层覆盖 Flash 与 Flash-Lite 系列模型（如 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 以及更新的 3.x Flash Lite 变体），输入输出 token 免费，RPM/RPD 配额相对宽裕，具体数值需在 Google AI Studio 查看且会随时间调整。API 提供原生协议并支持 OpenAI 兼容端点；免费层使用 Google 账号即可，无需绑定账单或信用卡。
